basic_info.description: Welcome to 45 Belvedere, nestled in the heart of San Francisco's charming Cole Valley neighborhood! This exquisite 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home includes a versatile office space on the lower level, perfect for remote work, an office, gym, kids play room and more.  As you step inside, you'll find an inviting living area with hardwood floors and ample natural light, creating a warm and welcoming ambiance. The updated kitchen boasts modern appliances, sleek countertops, and plenty of cabinet space, making it ideal for culinary enthusiasts.  The well-appointed bedrooms offer comfort and tranquility, perfect for unwinding after a long day. The lower level office provides flexibility for your lifestyle needs.  This home also includes the coveted perk of parking, ensuring hassle-free access in the city, along with additional storage space for your belongings.  Outside, enjoy the vibrant Cole Valley community, with its array of cafes, boutiques, and scenic parks just moments away. Explore nearby attractions such as Golden Gate Park, Haight-Ashbury, and more
